summary: Fix local queue project and dry-run boundaries (STARTER-602)

delivery.outcome: Explicit --project must be a real project root (no parent escalation); --dry-run produces no claim/start/block/lock/manager effects in single and loop modes.
nonGoals: Changing executor dispatch behavior for real (non-preview) runs
GitHub sync ordering or error reporting (covered by STARTER-603)
Planfile SDK auto-discovery semantics outside the CLI boundary

architecture.decision: Validate explicit --project at the CLI boundary; make the queue runner's mutation sites (lifecycle block, runner lock, run-log) conditional on not dry-run; skip local-manager session in preview modes.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; the change is confined to CLI validation and dry-run guards.

validation.evidence: Explicit --project without .planfile/koru.yaml exits 2; a marker-bearing child project is used verbatim.
Single and loop dry-run invoke no lifecycle command, no runner lock artifacts and no local-manager session, including incomplete tickets.
